input_messages.content: Hey there! So, I ordered a bunch of stuff recently—some home office gear and some hiking goodies—because I was planning to work from my parents' place in Seattle and enjoy the outdoors. But now, my company says we're heading back to the office soon. Is it possible to cancel just the office items from my order and keep the hiking stuff? Also, I'd like to know how much I'd get refunded and if the refund can go back to my original payment method. Thanks!
Sure thing! My name is Noah Patel, and my zip code is 10108. Unfortunately, I can't quite remember the email address I used for the order. Hopefully, that’s enough to find my order?

Ah, I see. Partial cancellation would have been perfect, but I get it. Since cancelling the whole order means I’d have to reorder the hiking stuff separately, which sounds like a hassle, I think I’ll just keep the order as it is for now. 

But since I’m going to be working from my parents’ place in Seattle, can you update my default shipping address to that Seattle address from this order? I don’t want to reveal the exact address here, but it’s the one on this order.
Yes, please go ahead and update my default address to the Seattle one. Thanks for helping me out with this!

No, that’s all for now. Thanks a lot for your help and patience! Hopefully, I’ll get to enjoy those hiking boots soon. Have a great day! 

###STOP###
